    strut_density = 0.05
    strut_h = deck_cy - ground_top
    strut_cy = ground_top + strut_h / 2
    left_span = sandbox.add_beam(
        x=span_left, y=deck_cy,
        width=0.5, height=deck_h,
        angle=0, density=density,
    )
    right_span = sandbox.add_beam(
        x=span_right, y=deck_cy,
        width=0.5, height=deck_h,
        angle=0, density=density,
    )
    deck_left = sandbox.add_beam(
        x=8.0, y=deck_cy,
        width=2.0, height=deck_h,
        angle=0, density=density,
    )
    deck_right = sandbox.add_beam(
        x=12.0, y=deck_cy,
        width=2.0, height=deck_h,
        angle=0, density=density,
    )
    strut_xs = [6.0, 7.0, 8.0, 9.0, 11.0, 12.0, 13.0, 14.0]
    strut_bodies = []
    for sx in strut_xs:
        s = sandbox.add_beam(
            x=sx, y=strut_cy,
            width=strut_w, height=strut_h,
            angle=0, density=strut_density,
        )
        strut_bodies.append((sx, s))
        sandbox.add_joint(s, None, (sx, ground_top), type="rigid")
        if sx <= 9:

            sandbox.add_joint(deck_right, s, (sx, deck_cy), type="rigid")
    sx_center = 10.0

        width=strut_w, height=strut_h,

    )
    sandbox.add_joint(strut_center, None, (sx_center, ground_top), type="rigid")
    sandbox.add_joint(deck_left, strut_center, (sx_center, deck_cy), type="rigid")
    sandbox.add_joint(deck_right, strut_center, (sx_center, deck_cy), type="pivot")
    sandbox.add_joint(left_span, deck_left, (7.0, deck_cy), type="rigid")
    sandbox.add_joint(deck_left, deck_right, (10.0, deck_cy), type="rigid")
    sandbox.add_joint(deck_right, right_span, (13.0, deck_cy), type="rigid")

    span_left, span_right = sandbox.get_span_bounds()
    # Ensure the span is from x <= 6.0 to x >= 14.0
    # Define deck height and thickness

    deck_h = 0.4  # Increased height for better load distribution
    # Density for beams
    density = 0.05
    
    # Left support beam
    left_support = sandbox.add_beam(x=span_left, y=deck_cy, width=2.0, height=deck_h, angle=0, density=density)
    # Right support beam
    right_support = sandbox.add_beam(x=span_right, y=deck_cy, width=2.0, height=deck_h, angle=0, density=density)
    
    # Connect left support to ground
    sandbox.add_joint(left_support, None, (span_left, ground_top), type='rigid')
    # Connect right support to ground
    sandbox.add_joint(right_support, None, (span_right, ground_top), type='rigid')
    
    # Central beam connecting left and right supports
    central_beam = sandbox.add_beam(x=(span_left + span_right)/2, y=deck_cy, width=2.0, height=deck_h, angle=0, density=density)
    
    # Connect central beam to left support
    sandbox.add_joint(left_support, central_beam, (span_left, deck_cy), type='rigid')
    # Connect central beam to right support
    sandbox.add_joint(right_support, central_beam, (span_right, deck_cy), type='rigid')
    
    # Add two additional beams to distribute load
    beam4 = sandbox.add_beam(x=span_left + 2.0, y=deck_cy, width=1.0, height=deck_h, angle=0, density=density)
    beam5 = sandbox.add_beam(x=span_right - 2.0, y=deck_cy, width=1.0, height=deck_h, angle=0, density=density)

    # Add a pivot joint between central beam and beam4 to allow controlled rotation
